findings.title: Embedded-post author link lightness values are swapped
findings.body: This was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), so the dark-light-choose conversion should preserve 30% for the light theme and use scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%) for the dark theme. Instead the line uses 70% for $primary and 30% for $secondary, inverting both branches: light-theme author links become much lighter/washed out and dark-theme links become too dark against a dark background.

findings.title: Custom-message-length lightness values are swapped
findings.body: This was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), so the conversion should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). Instead the line uses 30% for $primary and 70% for $secondary, inverting both branches: the hint text becomes much darker in light themes and much lighter than intended in dark themes, unlike the equivalent desktop rule which was converted correctly.

findings.title: Topic-map h3 light-theme colour changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: This was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), so the conversion should preserve 20% for the light theme and use scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%) for the dark theme, as done for the equivalent desktop topic-map heading. Instead both branches use 50%, lightening the light-theme heading substantially and giving the dark theme a mid-grey with lower contrast than the intended 80% secondary colour.

findings.title: Group-member name light-theme colour changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), so the conversion should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). Instead both branches use 50%, needlessly lightening member names in the light theme and making them darker than intended (70%) and lower-contrast in dark themes.

findings.title: Group-member name light-theme colour changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule was originally scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), so the conversion should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). Instead both branches use 50%, needlessly lightening member names in the light theme and making them darker than intended (70%) and lower-contrast in dark themes.
